entities.summary: Omar Almeida Quintana is a Cuban chess Grandmaster. Almeida Quintana became a Grandmaster in 2006 and his current FIDE rating is 2523. His highest achieved FIDE rating in the database is 2593. He is the 6th best chess player in Cuba as of May 2020.
